name: copperbench
description: copperbench: a benchmark for language-model agents on verified KiCad hardware design edits
author: Animesh Chouhan <animeshchouhan@outlook.com>

scripts.site:serve: npm run site && astro preview --root site

comments.copperhead-dependency: The runner drives the copperhead CLI as a user would, and the scorer reads artifacts it writes. Grading needs the read-only sexp parser, report normalizer, and drift check from copperhead's src/, which are published in its npm package but are NOT a stable public API. Pin an exact copperhead version when the runner lands, record it in every result record's comparability stamp, and treat an internals change as a suite-version event.
comments.not-yet-wired: benchmark, rescore, paper:generate, and paper:check-claims land with the runner, scorer, and paper generator. They are deliberately absent rather than present and broken. Suite validation ships ahead of the runner as npm run validate; benchmark --validate will delegate to it when the runner lands.
comments.cookie-hoist: cookie is not used by this project. It is pinned at the root so Node resolves astro's ESM cookie@2 instead of the CommonJS cookie@0.7 that express (under copperhead's agent SDK) hoists; without it astro's prerenderer fails to import parseCookie. Drop it when either side moves on.
